title: Attach for emergency bearer services not accepted by the network

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attach for emergency bearer services. When rejected by network, specific UE behaviors are triggered.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE when attach request cannot be accepted. Contains EMM cause values.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for attach rejection. Values include #5 'IMEI not accepted' and others.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI
entities.description: UE state entered when ATTACH REJECT with EMM cause #5 is received.

entities.name: EMM cause #5 received
entities.description: Condition when ATTACH REJECT includes EMM cause #5 'IMEI not accepted'.

entities.name: Other EMM cause received
entities.description: Condition when ATTACH REJECT includes EMM cause values other than #5.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of procedure failure
entities.description: UE behavior to notify upper layers about attach procedure failure, potentially triggering CS emergency call or other mechanisms.

entities.name: PLMN selection in shared network
entities.description: UE behavior in shared network to select alternative PLMN and potentially re-initiate attach for emergency services.

entities.name: In shared network
entities.description: Condition indicating UE is operating in a shared network environment.

relations.description: Procedure includes network sending ATTACH REJECT message when attach cannot be accepted.
ATTACH REJECT message contains EMM cause information element.
Receiving EMM cause #5 establishes UE state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.
Receiving other EMM cause values establishes UE behavior to inform upper layers of procedure failure.
Being in shared network establishes UE behavior to perform PLMN selection and potentially re-initiate attach.
EMM cause IE guards condition for EMM cause #5.
EMM cause IE guards condition for other EMM cause values.
